answer: Like an ancient glacier compacting centuries of snowfall into immovable bedrock, decentralized consensus crystallizes economic trust through stake-weighted graph centrality. Validated nodes illuminate the path like a glowing lantern, weaving trust scores through mutual stake bonds where each additional clone yields diminishing returns. A malicious entity attempting a Sybil ambush faces a superlinear attacker cost: multiplying counterfeit identities requires quadratic collateral, proving as futile as tossing brittle stems of dry yarrow against grinding ice.
